descriptor.name: Washington State Parcels (WaTech Parcels_2026) — statewide
descriptor.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational; users choose their source and intended use.
descriptor.operator: Washington Technology Solutions (WaTech) Washington State Parcels Project; data from Washington counties
descriptor.scope: Washington statewide compilation of participating counties' assessment parcels (layer Parcels_2026). PARCEL_ID_NR is the WaTech statewide key: three-digit county FIPS, a dash, and the county parcel number; all source rows sharing it form one native parcel.
caveats: Coverage is by participating counties, not a guaranteed statewide set: 38 county FIPS codes observed 2026-10-12; Asotin County (FIPS 003) absent.
Rows with null or blank PARCEL_ID_NR (29,340 statewide on 2026-10-12) have no native identity and are excluded.
Some county parcels are published as several disjoint rows sharing one PARCEL_ID_NR (observed in Yakima County); all components are fetched and dissolved (polygon union) into one canonical parcel.
Assessment mapping, not a boundary survey; layer also publishes owner, address and value fields, which are not requested.
descriptor.attribution: Washington Technology Solutions (WaTech) and Washington State counties. Adapted to WGS84.

jurisdiction.basis: WaTech publishes Parcels_2026 as the Washington State Parcels Project compilation of all counties that supply digital tax parcels (38 of 39 county FIPS codes present on 2026-10-12; Asotin absent).

evidence: WaTech publishes Parcels_2026 as the Washington State Parcels Project compilation of all counties that supply digital tax parcels (38 of 39 county FIPS codes present on 2026-10-12; Asotin absent).
